text: {"lessons":["Selling B, E, and C at gains felt rewarding, but a gain alone is not a reason to sell; weigh each holding’s outlook and my plan before locking it in.","My average cost is not a reason to keep a losing position or sell a winning one. I should judge each stock on its prospects, not on whether selling feels like admitting a mistake.","Selling A at a loss was painful, but holding it just to avoid admitting a mistake would not be a sound reason to stay invested; I should review its prospects objectively and make deliberate decisions rather than react to short-term account swings."]}
